types.name: CONTACT
types.text: Walks toward whatever it can hear. If it gets to you, it swings.

types.name: DRIFTER
types.text: Hunts you by ear from two compartments away. Further off, it just goes to the noise.

types.name: BURROWER
types.text: Lives in the ducts, so a dropped bulkhead means nothing to it. In the REACTOR it chews the output instead of you.

types.name: CHORUS
types.text: Makes for the ORE HOLD, singing, and the whole ship gets louder while it walks. When it gets home, more of them wake.
